## Fictional use case and intended improvement

What developer problem does this solve? Provide the smallest reproduction and expected vs actual result.

## Tests and evidence

- [ ] `npm test` passed, or explain the exact failure
- [ ] `npm run demo` passed, or explain why not relevant
- [ ] For UI changes, describe real browser, keyboard/focus and narrow-viewport checks (and what was **not** tested)
- [ ] For publishing changes, verify only the allowlisted static files are included

## Safety, provenance and limits

- [ ] Only original/redistributable source and fictional data
- [ ] No employer/customer data, personal records, credentials, telemetry or runtime dependencies accidentally introduced
- [ ] No unsupported accessibility certification or hosted-demo claim
- [ ] Relevant docs and negative regression cases updated
